description: Build the member's Applystead personal website (Premium) with the member's own agent: write and delete draft files and publish the draft. Sites are static HTML and CSS with no scripts: files are html, css, json, txt, xml, svg, md and images (no JavaScript). Pages may not run scripts (<script>, on...= attributes, javascript: links), ask for passwords or hold forms, redirect, or embed frames or other pages; such files are refused with a message saying what to change. Spends no points. Actions: write_file, delete_file, publish. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.
